scripts.generate:all: npm run generate:central && npm run generate:shard
scripts.migrate:central: npx dotenv -e .env -- npx prisma migrate dev --schema=./prisma/central/schema.prisma --name init_central
scripts.migrate:shard:create: npx dotenv -e .env.shard0 -- npx prisma migrate dev --schema=./prisma/shards/schema.prisma --name init_shards
scripts.migrate:shard:apply:1: npx dotenv -e .env.shard1 -- npx prisma migrate deploy --schema=./prisma/shards/schema.prisma
scripts.migrate:all: npm run migrate:central && npm run migrate:shard:create && npm run migrate:shard:apply:1
